role: galaxy (Seyfert 1 nucleus inside an extended host), fitted as a point source

queries.simbad_tap: SELECT main_id, ra, dec, pmra, pmdec, otype FROM basic WHERE main_id = 'NGC 4151' OR main_id = '* NGC 4151'
queries.irsa_tap_coverage: SELECT a.uri, p.energy_bandpassname, p.time_bounds_lower, p.time_bounds_upper, p.provenance_version FROM spherex.artifact a JOIN spherex.plane p ON a.planeid = p.planeid WHERE 1 = CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS', 182.63573326, 39.40585098), p.poly) ORDER BY p.time_bounds_lower
